title: TokTickIT Sprint 4 Visual and Accessibility QA Checklist
inspectedScreens: IT Staff Ticket Detail & Actions Taken Workspace

noClipping.description: Zero text or control clipping across viewports

noOverlap.description: Sufficient spacing between buttons, cards, and labels

visibleFocusStates.description: 2px solid #198754 focus ring on all interactive elements

nonColorStatusCues.description: Explicit readable textual badges for status, priority, and role

mobileTouchTargets.description: All interactive controls >= 44x44px on mobile viewports

semanticLabels.description: Accessible form labels, button labels, and landmark regions

editableVsReadOnly.description: Clear visual distinction between input fields and read-only displays

validationPlacement.description: Inline errors and alert banners positioned directly with controls

conclusion: All major Lab 4 screens satisfy the approved Zen Green visual, responsive, and accessibility contract.
